issues.title: Page 1 skips the first 20 orders
issues.explanation: The spec says pages start at 1, but offset = page * page_size makes page 1 start at row 20.

issues.title: SQL injection
issues.explanation: user_id comes from the URL and is interpolated straight into the SQL string.
issues.fix: Use placeholders: WHERE user_id = ? ... LIMIT ? OFFSET ? with (user_id, page_size, offset).

issues.title: N+1 query
issues.explanation: One order_items query runs per order, so a page costs 21 queries.
issues.fix: Fetch items for all order ids in one query (WHERE order_id IN (...)) or JOIN.
